defaults.t2: A transitional team, not a permanent one.
defaults.t5: s leadership is designed to be handed off to the community itself.
defaults.t7: We are a small team at the
defaults.t12: SPIRIT is guided by a small team of
defaults.t14: whose aim is to establish the Bioregional Commons that will determine its own character and trajectories through distributed, decentralized decision-making. Our explicit goal is to build something that will no longer need us so that we, too, can join the Commons as fellow commoners, with no more authority or say than anyone else. We do not pretend to have all the answers.
defaults.t16: What we have is our commitment to this place and to each other, and a willingness to learn in public.
defaults.t17: Our aim is for SPIRIT’s board to be comprised of highly-regarded community leaders, particularly elders and Indigenous relatives. For now, we Transitional Stewards show up with full commitment and open hands, oriented towards that ultimate transition.
